title: CR-BRK-001 — Reports in isolation — page must not crash
preconds: Reports \u2713 | everything else \u2717 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Log in; open Reports; open each report section.
expected:
Reports nav appears and the page loads. Reports is all-or-nothing (no per-report granularity), so all sections are reachable; sections may show empty data since no CRUD areas are granted, but the page must NOT crash. Login must succeed.

Risk / Rationale: Reports bypasses the section/data permission gate — page may crash or error when all data areas are OFF, or may surface data the user has no CRUD access to.
Spec Ref: §2a Reports
